description: Configuration for Strava Activity Heatmap Generator

ACTIVITIES_DIR.description: Path to the directory containing your Strava export data (activities.csv and .fit.gz/.gpx files)
ACTIVITIES_DIR.title: Activities Dir

ACTIVITY_TYPES.description: List of activity types to include in the heatmap. Can use canonical types (Run, Ride, Swim, etc.) or common aliases (Running, Cycling, Bike, etc.)
ACTIVITY_TYPES.title: Activity Types

DATE_FROM.description: Start date for filtering activities (YYYY-MM-DD). Use null for no start limit.
DATE_FROM.title: Date From

DATE_TO.description: End date for filtering activities (YYYY-MM-DD). Use null for no end limit.
DATE_TO.title: Date To

HOME_LAT.description: Home latitude for radius filtering. Use null to disable radius filtering.
HOME_LAT.title: Home Lat

HOME_LON.description: Home longitude for radius filtering. Use null to disable radius filtering.
HOME_LON.title: Home Lon

RADIUS_KM.description: Radius in kilometers around home location to include activities. Only used if HOME_LAT and HOME_LON are set.
RADIUS_KM.title: Radius Km

GPS_SPREAD_MIN_M.description: Minimum GPS spread in meters. Activities with less spread are treated as stationary.
GPS_SPREAD_MIN_M.title: Gps Spread Min M

METERS_PER_PIXEL.description: Ground resolution in meters per pixel for the heatmap raster.
METERS_PER_PIXEL.title: Meters Per Pixel

PADDING_M.description: Padding in meters around the activity bounds for the heatmap extent.
PADDING_M.title: Padding M

TRACK_CLIP_RADIUS_KM.description: Maximum distance in km from home to clip tracks. Tracks beyond this are clipped.
TRACK_CLIP_RADIUS_KM.title: Track Clip Radius Km

BLUR_SIGMA_PX.description: Gaussian blur sigma in pixels for smoothing the heatmap.
BLUR_SIGMA_PX.title: Blur Sigma Px

MAP_OPACITY.description: Opacity of the heatmap overlay (0.0 to 1.0).
MAP_OPACITY.title: Map Opacity

SPEED_MIN_MS.description: Minimum speed in m/s to include GPS points. Use null for no minimum.
SPEED_MIN_MS.title: Speed Min Ms

SPEED_MAX_MS.description: Maximum speed in m/s to include GPS points. Use null for no maximum.
SPEED_MAX_MS.title: Speed Max Ms

HR_MIN_BPM.description: Minimum heart rate in BPM to include GPS points. Use null for no minimum.
HR_MIN_BPM.title: Hr Min Bpm

HR_MAX_BPM.description: Maximum heart rate in BPM to include GPS points. Use null for no maximum.
HR_MAX_BPM.title: Hr Max Bpm

AUTO_RANGE_PCT.description: Percentile for auto-ranging color scale (0-100). Lower values increase contrast.
AUTO_RANGE_PCT.title: Auto Range Pct

MAX_CONSECUTIVE_SAME_CELL.description: Maximum consecutive GPS points in the same raster cell before skipping.
MAX_CONSECUTIVE_SAME_CELL.title: Max Consecutive Same Cell

DECAY_FACTOR.description: Decay factor for temporal fading of older activities (0.0 to 1.0).
DECAY_FACTOR.title: Decay Factor

CACHE_DIR.description: Directory for cached data (relative to project root).
CACHE_DIR.title: Cache Dir

OUTPUT_DIR.description: Directory for output files (relative to project root).
OUTPUT_DIR.title: Output Dir

ACTIVITIES_CSV.description: Name of the activities CSV file in ACTIVITIES_DIR.
ACTIVITIES_CSV.title: Activities Csv

CACHE_FILE.description: Name of the cache file in CACHE_DIR.
CACHE_FILE.title: Cache File

OUTPUT_HTML.description: Name of the output HTML file in OUTPUT_DIR.
OUTPUT_HTML.title: Output Html

title: Strava Heatmap Configuration
